sources.summary: Local architecture practice Rerucha Studio has arranged a cedar-clad house with detached elements around a central courtyard to function like a park in Seattle, Washington, USA. Aptly named Park House, the 2,500-square-foot (232-square-metre) residence spreads into three distinct structures connected by a steel trellis across its site.
